basic_info.description: Located just blocks from Ocean Beach, this bright and inviting tunnel-entry Parkside home offers timeless charm and tremendous potential. The main level features gleaming hardwood floors, two spacious west-facing bedrooms, a generous living room with corner fireplace, a formal dining room, an eat-in kitchen, and a full bath showcasing original details. The lower level offers potential for expansion with a generous bonus room, ideal for use as a bedroom, den or office, a large garage with interior access, laundry area, and ample storage space. Outdoors, the sunny, west-facing, level yard is perfect for gardening, dining, or relaxing. Located in the heart of the Parkside district, this home balances coastal tranquility with city convenience. Enjoy easy access to Pine Lake Park and Stern Grove, Ocean Beach, local cafes, shops, and restaurants, plus nearby Muni and major routes for a seamless commute.
